title: The Blackwood Manor Murder
scene: The study of Blackwood Manor, shortly after midnight.
summary: Alistair Blackwood was found dead in his study after a night of rain and raised voices. Five people remain in the house, and each of them is hiding something.
coverStory: You were in the drawing room all night and only heard the commotion from the study.

timeline.text: Victor confronts Alistair about the missing company funds.
Victor strikes Alistair and stages the scene before leaving.
Margaret hears a heavy thud but stays in the kitchen.
Evelyn notices Victor return from the study, breathing hard.

clues.text: A torn ledger page shows transfers routed to an offshore account.
A shattered tumbler lies beside the desk, wiped clean of prints.
Muddy footprints lead from the front door to the study and back.
An unsigned will draft leaves the estate to Evelyn and removes Victor as a beneficiary.
A stopped pocket watch reads 12:07, well after the household claims to have retired.
A solicitor's letter addressed to Evelyn is tucked behind a cushion.
The kitchen clock stopped at 12:05, matching the sound Margaret heard.

memories: You saw Victor return from the study with his collar loose.
You opened the study safe for Alistair before dinner.
You heard Victor and your father arguing about money.
You heard a thud at about five past midnight.
You know the ledger page is missing from the study.

redHerrings.text: A bloodstained glove that turns out to be from the kitchen staff's cut hand.
A love letter suggesting an affair that never happened.
A hidden wall panel containing old debts unrelated to the murder.

hintTemplates.template: The person with the strongest financial motive was the last to see the victim.
The study's desk holds a document that changes who benefits from the estate.
Compare what the staff heard near midnight with the time the study clock was stopped.
